production.change: Retry only an interrupted native poll through the existing passive wait loop. The next iteration repeats owner checks when applicable and recomputes the remaining time from the existing CLOCK_BOOTTIME deadline.

method.probe: A private serial test used an anonymous socket pair, a test-local caught signal and a counter attached to the actual native EINTR branch. The expiry sender continued through the late-readiness point. The test restored its signal disposition and mask after both senders had joined.
method.test_overlay: The native fixture added the test-only Rust counter and control plus a C signal helper in its isolated source package.

preserved_preparation.reason: The fixture manifest was rejected before native compilation because its list of archived unit-test assertions had changed.

scope: One ordinary-user native passive-wait regression. The observation times come from the original probe cutoff. Whole-service lifecycle, Linux backend qualification, and comparative performance have separate acceptance criteria.
